ipa.financial_contracts.bond.AmortizationItem

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.bond.AmortizationItem.

Syntax

AmortizationItem(
    *,
    start_date: OptDateTime = None,
    end_date: OptDateTime = None,
    amortization_frequency: AmortizationFrequency | None = None,
    amortization_type: AmortizationType | str = None,
    remaining_notional: float | None = None,
    amount: float | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
start_date OptDateTime No None Start Date of an amortization section/window, or stepped rate
end_date OptDateTime No None End Date of an amortization section/window, or stepped rate
amortization_frequency AmortizationFrequency | None No None Frequency of the Amortization
amortization_type AmortizationType | str No None Amortization type Annuity, Schedule, Linear, ....
remaining_notional float | None No None The Remaining Notional Amount after Amortization
amount float | None No None Amortization Amount at each Amortization Date

Example

amortization_item = AmortizationItem(
    start_date="2021-02-11",
    end_date="2022-02-11",
    amount=100000,
    amortization_type=AmortizationType.SCHEDULE
)
amortization_item
